prompt:
Create four independent realistic studio portrait photographs of FOUR unrelated fictional Korean male baseball athletes in a 2x2 grid. Normal healthy human proportions and natural facial anatomy are absolutely essential. They should look like ordinary people you would meet at a Korean baseball academy or university team. Normal eye spacing, normal nose and mouth sizes, balanced facial proportions, no exaggerated features, no caricature, no facial distortions. All wear a relaxed gentle small smile, approachable calm expression, eyes looking toward camera. Authentic youthful appearance for the stated ages, no celebrities. Show entire hair, head, neck and clavicle with comfortable headroom. Plain white unbranded baseball jerseys, no hats, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft flattering even lighting, natural real skin texture, no beauty filter. Variety comes from realistic subtle differences in jaw shape, eyebrows, eyelids, nose shape, hairstyle and athletic build. Keep the features harmonious and believable. Exactly four equal square photos, no text, numbering, borders or watermark. Respect each person's hair, eyewear, facial hair and age in these briefs; interpret every feature at normal natural scale:
